scope: All frozen work-log/evidence tracked paths excluding 103 ZIP containers and 429 conventional video/audio filename-extension paths; metadata coverage and conservative triage, not consumer clearance.
method: Join exact Git path/blob/size identities for 22 nonconventional original recording files/parts and 1,365 frame entries with previously audited sources; group every remaining unclassified path by family and filename extension. No binary data opened, no new media viewing or SHA rehash.
disposition_policy: All 13,771 remaining paths stay REVIEW_REQUIRED and protected from deletion; previous 22 recorded originals are RETAIN_FOR_NOW, previous 1,365 frames retain their specific technical pass labels but none is deletion-approved.
limits: A file extension is not a reliable original/derived classification; inventory counts alone do not establish release or remove permission.

The 15,158 non-ZIP/nonconventional paths may include other videos in extensionless or part names not among the 22 verified originals; no exhaustive magic-byte sniffing was done.
Prior frame dispositions are proposed technical groupings, not completed consumer/timepoint reviews or deletion allowlists.
All decisions preserve original Blitzit/current native evidence and earlier batch-2 safety rejection. No deletion/move, CI/native NOT RUN.
